notes: From your 0.7.1 video: Background choice is now self-proving - tapping Phone wallpaper or Kinto wallpaper in Appearance takes you straight to Home with a confirmation, the Appearance page states which background is currently showing, and selected options get the ember highlight + checkmark everywhere in Settings. Native wallpaper compositing hardened (decor view cleared, flags re-asserted every time you return to the launcher, change-only bridge). Studio: top bar and panel are now opaque and clear of the Home headline, and while editing, the Lens you drag is the web Lens inside its dashed outline (no more native-orb lag/ghosting); Studio atmospheres renamed to Basalt/Iris/Midnight/Daybreak to match Appearance. Horizon day taps no longer flash the blue system highlight; empty-state ladder beads are uniform. Reach labels have real spacing. Long views (Ask Kinto, Settings) keep your scroll position across refreshes. ChatGPT no longer truncates to 'Chat...'. The giant in-pane Settings titles are gone (the bar carries the title).
